scope: Ordinary classical Lean proofs for Y, RPD, LRD, Omega-LRD3, ARD, IPD and ARD2, not object-language KP derivations. Y uses the pinned upstream definition, not a global JavaScript equivalence theorem. ARD and ARD2 include independent finite-rule and compressed/full-root bridges. ARD2 constructs both SELF endpoint cases and its actual full-context staged splice. IPD includes the actual recursive tree comparison and full staged-splice descent, with a separate paper audit for JavaScript pruning. No compiler-level Python or JavaScript verification or relative order-type comparison is claimed.
